objective: Define the visible oscillatory phenomenon and the question to test.
input_contract: Creator-approved video observation or abstract target; no recipe required.
acceptance_gate: Question, observable, and units are explicit.

objective: Fit or stress-test the dimensionless well-mixed and spatial Oregonator layers.
input_contract: Normalized parameters, initial state, and numerical tolerances.
acceptance_gate: Solver success, peak detection, and parameter sensitivity are reported.

objective: Select a creator- and chemist-approved elementary step for molecular study.
input_contract: Mapped 3-D reactant and product structures with provenance.
acceptance_gate: Atom ordering matches; charge, spin, geometry source, and scope are recorded.
safety_boundary: Structures are not inferred from the video and no recipe is generated.

objective: Characterize the selected elementary step with bounded managed molecular modeling.
input_contract: Approved 3-D endpoints, method/settings, and explicit Vicena credit cap.
output_artifact: Rowan UUID, path energies, TS candidate, and provider provenance.
acceptance_gate: Submission is authorized; TS is checked with frequencies and, when appropriate, IRC.
safety_boundary: Rowan models selected elementary steps, not the full BZ oscillatory network.

objective: Compare model phase, period, and waveform shape to an anonymized intensity trace.
input_contract: CSV with time and intensity proxy; calibration metadata.
acceptance_gate: Timebase, preprocessing, and residuals are visible.
safety_boundary: No private lab data or hazardous procedure is required.

objective: Return a concise failure-aware summary for scientific critique.
acceptance_gate: Claims are separated into measured, computed, and unknown.
safety_boundary: No endorsement is requested or implied.
